definitions.explanation: Money one earns through work, or the activity of earning it. Often refers to a person's take-home pay or livelihood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: My earnings are low this month.
He earns well, so he has some financial leeway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{稼|かせ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To support my family, I'm looking for a better-paying job.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧ (to earn). Refers to the money earned through work, or to earning itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {稼|かせ}ぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: earns well; well-paying
- {稼|かせ}ぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: earns little
- ⟦{共稼|ともかせ}ぎ→共稼ぎ：18260_tomokasegi⟧: both spouses working; dual-income
- ⟦{出稼|でかせ}ぎ→出稼ぎ：14879_dekasegi⟧: working away from home

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧: income — more formal and neutral
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧: salary — fixed pay from an employer
